description.narrative: EDP, S.A. (EDP or the Company), is a global energy company domiciled in Portugal. IFCs proposed financing consists of a 7-year unsecured corporate loan of up to US$ 250 million to EDP and certain of its financing subsidiaries. The proceeds will be primarily used to support Los Cuervos solar park in Mexico and potentially other eligible Category B (as defined per IFCs Policy on E&S Sustainability, 2012) renewable energy generation project(s) in other emerging market(s), developed and owned through one of its subsidiaries, EDP Renovaveis, S.A. (EDPR).

The proposed main project outcomes are environmental effects (reduction in GHG emissions) due to increased renewable capacity and hence decarbonization of Mexicos energy mix. At the market level, the project is intended to improve resilience by increasing the share of renewable in their electricity generation mix and improve market competitiveness by demonstrating the viability of bilateral PPAs in a challenging regulatory environment.
